svg.title: YaMoRC YD7010 Command Station - Fritzing Breadboard View
svg.desc: Top-view breadboard artwork with Fritzing-style connector IDs. Background artwork is embedded unchanged as PNG for visual fidelity. Connector mapping: 0 LAN, 1 ES-IN-LINK/S88N-IN, 2 LocoNET B, 3 LocoNET T, 4-5 TRACK OUTPUT screws, 6 XBus/RBus, 7 BBus, 8-9 RS Bus screws, 10-11 PROG TRACK screws, 12 USB 2.0, 13 POWER SUPPLY.
